shortDescription: Move a virtual machine using vMotion, and/or its vmdks using storage vMotion.

options.name: destination_cluster
options.description: Name of the destination cluster the virtual machine should be running on. Only works if drs is enabled for this cluster.

options.name: destination_datacenter
options.description: Name of the destination datacenter the datastore is located on. Optional, required only when datastores are shared across datacenters.

options.name: destination_datastore
options.description: Name of the destination datastore the virtual machine's vmdk should be moved on.

options.name: destination_datastore_cluster
options.description: Name of the destination datastore cluster (storage pod) the virtual machine's vmdk should be moved on. Only works if drs is enabled for the cluster the vm is running / should run.

options.name: destination_host
options.description: Name of the destination host the virtual machine should be running on. Version 2.6 onwards, this parameter is not a required parameter, unlike the previous versions.

options.name: destination_resourcepool
options.description: Name of the destination resource pool where the virtual machine should be running. Resource pool is required if vmotion is done between hosts which are part of different clusters or datacenters. if not passed, resource_pool object will be retrived from host_obj parent.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the instance to manage if known, this is a unique identifier only within a single vCenter instance. This is required if O(vm_name) or O(vm_uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds. When the timeout is reached, the module will fail.

options.name: use_instance_uuid
options.description: Whether to use the VMware instance UUID rather than the BIOS UUID.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the VM to perform a vMotion on. This is required parameter, if O(vm_uuid) is not set.

options.name: vm_uuid
options.description: UUID of the virtual machine to perform a vMotion operation on. This is a required parameter, if O(vm_name) or O(moid) is not set.
